prompt: Create a Grade 3 Sharing the Planet standalone game about the water cycle and human impact. Include inquiry-based mechanics, TTS voice switching, and Neobrutalism styling.
expected_outputs: Traces to Grade 3 Sharing the Planet theme and lines of inquiry/key concepts (Change, Causation, Responsibility)

Interactive inquiry manipulative rather than a plain text quiz

Includes entry for src/data/curriculum-map.json

prompt: I want to create a Grade 2 science activity about light, shadows, and opaque vs transparent objects for How the World Works. What kind of interactive game should I build, and why? Please recommend the best game type and explain how the gameplay will work.
expected_outputs: Recommends Type 4 (3D Spatial Inspector) or Type 3 (Interactive Concept Lab) with clear pedagogical rationale explaining why 3D spatial depth and ray occlusion are essential for optics learning
Contrasts recommended archetype against alternatives (e.g. explaining why 3D diorama/manipulatives outperform 2D text quizzes for shadow formation)
Clarifies differentiated interactive gameplay mechanics: 3D orbit controls, movable light source, real-time shadow projection, object material opacity toggles, and zero pre-selection challenge cases
Maps to PYP theme How the World Works, Key Concepts (Form, Causation), and Explore-First flow
